rules.structure: Strict completed close crossing the most recent eligible confirmed swing; no wick-only break, no future/right-hand pivot borrowing, each pivot consumed once per direction.
rules.displacement: Directional close body at least 1.00 times the arithmetic mean of the previous 14 same-timeframe True Ranges, and body/range at least 0.60. Previous ranges exclude the break bar. These are explicit uncalibrated research-profile defaults, not a recovered numerical policy or profitability claim.
rules.source: Last opposite-colour completed candle among the previous 20 candles, before the qualifying break. Dojis do not qualify. Full source high/low define the zone: BUY proximal=high/distal=low; SELL proximal=low/distal=high.
rules.lifecycle: Only bars after the confirming break count as touches. Strict completed close beyond distal invalidates; wick contact alone touches. Invalidation is terminal. Revisions retain causal availability; a corrected-away event is invalidated, never deleted from historical reads.
rules.activation: Default off. Enabling starts ORDER_BLOCK publication through the existing scanner. Disabling suppresses current projection without deleting historical research. Re-enabling recomputes coherent current state.
rules.scope: W1/D1/H4/H1 independently from canonical source-scoped completed bars. Bounded trailing 2048 bars and latest 64 break events per frame; not a claim of exhaustive all-history scanning.
rules.execution: No MarketCandidate, fabricated qualification gates, confidence probability, risk sizing or broker command. Human Issue and cancellation remain separately owned by core. This is not complete M21A execution qualification.
